about_the_game:
Inuyo Academy, the best school on earth!

The Inuyo Academy was once a thriving all-ages school, full of many wonderful students eager to learn. One day, something terrible happened after the mascot staff was introduced to the children. The students disappeared, and it’s your job to figure out what really caused this.

Explore the abandoned halls

Inuyo Academy has been left abandoned for years, and the staff has remained silent regarding the incident. As an officer, you must wander the halls of the abandoned school, searching for any evidence you can find leading to the truth.

You’re not alone…

But something isn’t right… you aren’t alone. The school’s mascot staff still remains inside the building, and you must make sure to stay safe from them. You are also given a taser tool to help you unlock doors and efficiently make your way through the building.

But above all…

Avoid the monsters. Find the evidence. Stay alive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Additional Notes: There is a settings menu to change the graphics for lower-end devices. (You should also be an enjoyer of pink dogs to play this game.)

short_description: Welcome to Inuyo Academy, an all-ages school once filled with joy. Something terrible happened after the school’s mascot staff was revealed to the public, and it’s your job as an officer to investigate the abandoned building, in search of evidence to figure out the truth.
